result.brief: 提出SurgWorld：以空间/时间位移为伪动作的潜空间预测式自监督视频表征学习框架，结合几何视觉相似性对齐，在17个手术基准上验证迁移效果。
result.reason: Self-supervised video representation learning with latent predictive world-model objective (pseudo-action shifts) and representation alignment; directly matches visual/video representation interests.
